Take your campaign to another fundraising platform

Keep the campaign you wrote here, choose an independent fundraising host and publish it there. This export is a text kit, not automatic publishing, a host account connection or proof of partnership.

Open a fundraising destination

Visit GoFundMe (new tab)Visit Givebutter (new tab)Visit FundRazr (new tab)

These are independent destinations, not confirmed iFund partners. Paste your content and upload images manually. Donations, receipts and fees remain entirely with your chosen host; iFund does not collect the host's gifts or apply its first-party withdrawal fee.

Your campaign details

Add a working title to save these answers as a private account draft. You can change it as you build your campaign.

What kind of campaign are you creating?

Choose a starting direction. Generate five title ideas, two short descriptions and one editable story.

Get writing suggestions, check the facts, and choose what to include in your campaign. Your setup answers, writing preferences and progress are saved privately with your campaign when you save your account draft. Apply the suggestions you want to keep to your campaign title, description, or story before leaving.

Writing preferences guide proposed copy. They never authorize publishing, messages or financial actions.

Campaign writing assistant

Write as much or as little as you need. There is no minimum story length or required paragraph format.

Campaign cover image (optional)

Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF image up to 5 MB. Uploaded covers are publicly viewable when someone has their link; do not upload private documents or images without permission.

This setup note stays private. Public Atlas placement below is a separate choice.

Public Atlas map location (optional)

Opted-out campaigns have no coordinates saved or shared. Opting in publishes the label and broad coordinates for active campaigns.

Before you publish

  • Add a campaign title.
  • Add your campaign story before publishing.
  • Set a fundraising goal before publishing.
